cases.rationale: fastdvdnet shows the highest MUSIQ (32.59) and lowest BRISQUE (35.31) among candidates, indicating the best appearance quality. It also has the lowest disagreement (0.111) with the capture, suggesting the most reliable speaking-state decisions. The comparison with capture shows a positive delta in both MUSIQ and BRISQUE, indicating quality improvement.

spatial_nlm has the highest MUSIQ (16.17) and lowest BRISQUE (40.22) scores, indicating the best appearance quality. Comparisons show it has the smallest mean absolute score change and highest delta_MUSIQ improvement over capture, suggesting it is the most reliable candidate for decision-making. All candidates agree on not_speaking for the entire duration.
